scope: Selected pipeline-supervision contract, added after the original 12724a544 inventory. Sources resolve at this snapshot. This adds design states, not an implemented supervisor or a recount of the older ledgers.
counting_rule: Count named local states excluding shared aliases and distinct non-self directed edges. Count the supervisor policy once and the pipeline-slot ownership type once, without multiplying by pipelines or forming a global state product.
exclusions: Generic task execution, completion, panic and cancellation remain in the shared runtime inventory. A retained task handle can refer to a completed task until the supervisor observes its result.

Backoff duration, retry counters, pipeline count, JoinSet selection and optional stuck-task progress checks remain implementation choices. No polling loop, spawn permit, timer task or extra execution queue is inferred.
Supervisor wait/select topology and corresponding owner-qualified dependency states remain unenumerated. This addition counts restart permission and handle/backoff ownership only.
Draining disables replacement. The contract does not yet specify how active pipelines are stopped or joined during drain, so no additional cancellation/join protocol is counted.
Restart changes local processing capacity only. Assignment eligibility, retry thresholds and publication winners remain in the existing file protocol graphs.
Process-wide restart belongs to the deployment system and is outside this supervisor's contract.

edges: indexer enters drain or shutdown; no further pipeline replacements are allowed
graphs.notes: One supervisor per indexer process owns this policy. No resume-from-drain transition is selected. Disabling restarts does not itself assert that running pipelines have exited or that their resources are released.

edges: supervisor starts a pipeline while starts are permitted
supervisor observes an error, panic or unexpected exit while restarts are enabled
backoff has elapsed and restarts remain enabled; supervisor starts replacement
supervisor observes task completion while restarts are disabled
drain or shutdown suppresses the pending replacement
graphs.notes: This is the supervisor's ownership/replacement obligation for one pipeline slot, not another task execution graph. task_handle_owned includes an idle pipeline and a completed task whose result has not yet been observed. Errors, panics and unexpected exits share the same restart edge. no_task means no owned pipeline and no pending replacement obligation; it does not assert cancellation of any timer implementation. Processing another file does not change this ownership state. Replacements leave input assignment and completion unchanged.
